candidate.name: G1T3-drop-pure-integer-query-only
candidate.change: leave all indexed documents, C0, exact surfaces, teacher representation and fusion unchanged; remove pure integer tokens only from G1 and teacher query token streams
candidate.complexity_delta: one deterministic query-token predicate in two existing expansion scorers; no index change, model, lane, score calibration, stopword list, stemming, subwords, embeddings or inference

why_query_only: The rejected document+query sanitation changed BM25 corpus length normalization and caused the prefrozen Svetsteknik regression despite its query containing no numbers. Query-only sanitation is ranking-identical for no-number queries because neither documents nor their statistics change.
evidence_boundary: Every suite above was already opened when this query-only rule was designed. These results nominate the rule but cannot independently validate or promote it.
decision: Freeze this exact rule before inspecting any new numeric source-attested holdout. If no natural unused source slice exists, do not manufacture one and do not promote from opened evidence alone.
